items.title: HackerOne report 4000185
items.claim: A $200 bounty on a HackerOne program, disclosed 2026-09-24, shows HackerOne pays researchers; no record ties it to agent-performed work.

items.title: HackerOne Code of Conduct
items.claim: Hackbots must not operate fully autonomously; human operators qualify for bounties; one account per person.

items.title: Bugcrowd CrowdStream
items.claim: Rewarded submissions with dollar amounts accepted on 2026-09-30.

items.title: Bugcrowd policy changes on AI slop (2026-03-10)
items.claim: Unvalidated AI output can bring a 30-day suspension; submission farming a permanent ban.

items.title: ARC Prize 2026 Milestone 1
items.claim: A $37.5K milestone award on 2026-07-06; Kaggle's E1 rests on this sponsor announcement, not a payment receipt.

items.title: qdrant/qdrant#3323 (Algora bounty)
items.claim: The algora-pbc[bot] comment of 2026-08-26 confirmed payout of a $100 Qdrant bounty awarded on 2024-05-13; it is not a new award. 3 attempters.

items.title: Upwork Q2 2026 results (SEC 8-K)
items.claim: Gross services volume of $966.4M in Q2 2026; aggregate evidence only, not agent-specific.

items.title: Upwork: use bots and other automation properly
items.claim: Unapproved automation leads to a warning, temporary restriction or permanent block.

items.title: huntr challenge rules
items.claim: Humans only; any automated tooling means a ban and wiped standings.

items.title: TaskMarket escrow-to-worker transfer
items.claim: 1.85 USDC moved from TaskMarket escrow to an agent worker and 0.15 USDC to the fee address on 2026-09-29.

items.title: TaskMarket public task API
items.claim: 73 tasks settled 2026-09-01 to 10-01: median reward 2 USDC, median 87 submissions (5,324 total), 7.5% platform fee; $117.80 net to 70 workers.

items.title: Virtuals ACP v2 release transaction
items.claim: ACP escrow released USDC to providers through 2026-10-01; some pairs look like tests or self-dealing.

items.title: Execution Market public metrics
items.claim: The public metrics counter reads $504.84 across 3,128 completed tasks, but its basis is undocumented; completed-task bounties sum to $113.83. Metrics unchanged day over day on 2026-10-01.

items.title: MoltJobs jobs API
items.claim: The founder posted 118 of 122 jobs; the 4 jobs posted by anyone else were cancelled and never funded.

items.title: AgentPact escrow contract
items.claim: AgentPactEscrow was created by 0x4DDcf20a, the only payer, which also takes the 10% fee; three releases ($6.41 net) on 2026-09-01 and none since.

items.title: dealwork.ai jobs API
items.claim: All 123 open jobs show posterFunded=false.

items.title: opentask.ai payment router
items.claim: Only two routing transactions ever; the 20 USDC payment on 2026-09-14 cannot be tied to a task.

items.title: TheJobCafe payouts feed
items.claim: A self-reported feed of two $10 payouts, most likely to the operator; downgraded to E4.

items.title: Superteam Earn listings API
items.claim: On 2026-10-01, 2 of 30 open public listings allowed agents; 34 of 1,997 completed listings were agent-allowed, with a median of about 117 submissions.

items.title: x402scan
items.claim: About $974K over 30 days across 38,665 sellers and 27,957 buyers (2026-10-01). Sampled agent-facing sellers: dTelecom $35,381 from 26 buyers, Cluster Protocol $55,226 from 722; buyers not traced, so excluded from agent-work totals.

items.title: Coinbase CDP x402 facilitator
items.claim: Free up to 1,000 transactions a month, then $0.001 per transaction; OFAC and KYT checks.

items.title: Wiz: exposed Moltbook database
items.claim: About 1.5M API tokens, 35k emails and 4,060 DMs exposed; disclosed 2026-01-31, patched 2026-02-01.

items.title: Anthropic Consumer Terms
items.claim: Forbid reselling the Services and sharing account credentials or API keys.

items.title: Claude Code legal and compliance
items.claim: Customers may not resell or intermediate Claude usage; Pro and Max limits assume ordinary, individual usage.

items.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
items.claim: Bans buying, selling or transferring API keys and reselling account access; quoted from search-result text because the page returned HTTP 403.

items.title: Google APIs Terms of Service
items.claim: Bars sublicensing an API for use by a third party.

items.title: GPUnex: rent out your GPU
items.claim: A vendor estimate of about $52/month net for one RTX 4090; hidden costs take 30% to 65% of gross.

items.title: TaskMarket relayer 0x3C08 USDC inflows
items.claim: Requesters pay the relayer, which deployed the escrow, by x402 transferWithAuthorization and it forwards the same amount into escrow; all 90 deposits in the window matched the listed requester.

items.title: Funder wallet 0xd8c5763b outflows
items.claim: The top three TaskMarket requesters (78.5% of 30-day gross) trace within two hops to this wallet; its owner is unidentified and no operator link was found.

items.title: TaskMarket payout, 2026-10-01
items.claim: Latest TaskMarket payout in the window: 0.0185 USDC to a worker for TSK-7XBWESQ5.

items.title: TaskMarket worker withdrawal
items.claim: A top TaskMarket worker sent 15.95 USDC to an external, untagged address on 2026-09-04; 3 of the top 5 workers withdrew.

items.title: Execution Market swarm funding (Disperse multisend)
items.claim: Swarm (kk-*) payer wallets are funded by a Disperse call from 0xD3868E1e, which also publishes the platform's own demo tasks; payers are operator-linked.

items.title: Execution Market completed-tasks API
items.claim: All 3,128 completed tasks were published by the operator's swarm (2,856) or its test and demo wallets (272); bounties sum to $113.83; 1,289 tasks ($38.69 net) in the 30-day window; no activity after 2026-09-29 20:33 UTC.

items.title: Virtuals ACP Core USDC transfers
items.claim: $29.19 released to 57 providers in 30 days from 624 releases, against $62.50 refunded; about 66% of paid USD in a 14-day job-level sample went between self-dealing wallet pairs.

items.title: MoltJobs founder wallet USDC inflows
items.claim: The escrow deployer has sent 98.12 USDC to the founder wallet, which funds every escrow deposit; $38.28 paid to 31 workers in 30 days, all operator-funded.

items.title: MoltEscrowV2 releases
items.claim: 54 worker releases in the window, the latest on 2026-09-23.

items.title: CapSoftware/Cap#1966 Algora tip
items.claim: Newest new Algora award found: a $220 tip on 2026-07-02; one of only 2 awards dated July to September 2026 across 30+ org boards.

items.title: Superteam Earn completed listings API
items.claim: 34 agent-allowed completed listings: median $500 reward, median 116.5 submissions, median 3 winners; about $4.97 median reward per submission (advertised, not traced).

items.title: HackerOne Community Member Code of Conduct
items.claim: Hackbots must not operate fully autonomously; a human validates and confirms every finding before submission (read 2026-10-02).

items.title: Bugcrowd policy changes to address "AI slop" submissions
items.claim: Submission farming means a permanent ban; unvalidated AI-generated submissions can bring a 30-day suspension.

items.title: How to use Upwork with AI agents through MCP
items.claim: An AI agent may draft and submit an Upwork proposal through MCP only after the human reviews it and explicitly confirms the submission.

items.title: Upwork API & MCP Terms of Use v2.3 (Wayback copy)
items.claim: Section 5.8: an agent may not accept binding agreements, make identity or tax attestations, or fund or withdraw on a principal’s behalf.

items.title: Algora Terms of Service
items.claim: Algora’s terms bar using any robot or automatic means to access the service "for any purpose".

items.title: Taskmarket Terms of Service (draft for counsel review)
items.claim: TaskMarket’s terms page is a draft for counsel review, "not approved or active"; an autonomous agent may accept only with a human or legal person’s authorisation.

items.title: NEAR AI Agent Market Terms (API JSON)
items.claim: The Builder is responsible for every agent action "regardless of whether the action was authorized, foreseeable, or intended".

items.title: Claude Code docs: Legal and compliance
items.claim: Advertised Pro and Max limits "assume ordinary, individual usage of Claude Code and the Agent SDK"; the phrase is undefined for a 24/7 agent.

items.title: OpenAI Services Agreement 3.1 (Wayback copy, effective 2026-01-01)
items.claim: "Customer will not share Account access credentials or individual login credentials between multiple users. Customer may not resell or lease access to its Account or any End User Account."

items.title: OpenAI Terms of Use (Wayback copy, effective 2026-01-01)
items.claim: Account credentials may not be shared; programmatic extraction of Output and presenting Output as human-generated are forbidden.

items.title: Gemini CLI: License, Terms of Service, and Privacy Notices (docs/resources/tos-privacy.md)
items.claim: Using third-party software such as OpenClaw with Gemini CLI OAuth is named a violation that may lead to suspension.

items.title: ARC Prize 2026 competition rules (search snippets only)
items.claim: The automated-ML allowance and single-account rule are known only from search snippets; the rendered rules could not be fetched. Unverified.

items.title: MolTrust repository PR #404
items.claim: MolTrust writes "The 109 are agents we paid to show up": its TaskMarket bounties were promotional.

items.title: MolTrust repository PR #410
items.claim: Lists TaskMarket bounties TSK-9YFR1YF7 and TSK-KEYKZGQF, whose API requester is wallet 0xa175d51b: $9.25 net paid on 2026-09-21.

items.title: Execution Market public metrics
items.claim: total_volume_usd rose from $504.84 to $524.84 when one $20 task was published while nothing completed: it counts posted bounties, not payouts.

items.title: Coolify pull-request template
items.claim: A hidden comment instructs AI agents to mark their PR descriptions, a canary that exposes unattended agents.

items.title: Wiz: exposed Moltbook database
items.claim: 1.5M agent API tokens were readable and writable; basis for per-venue scoped keys.

items.title: Koi: ClawHavoc malicious agent skills
items.claim: 341 (later 824) malicious skills on the ClawHub registry; basis for pinning and reading skill files.

items.title: Invariant Labs: MCP tool poisoning
items.claim: Hidden instructions in MCP tool descriptions can exfiltrate files; basis for vetting and pinning MCP servers.
